metadata.body:
Use interface-qualified method names in Spring RMI preview telemetry so client and server report the same RPC identity. Legacy attributes and span names remain unchanged.

```properties
otel.semconv-stability.preview=rpc
```

Set the value to `rpc/dup` to emit both legacy and preview attributes.
